definitions.explanation: Ceramic ware in general, especially everyday dishes, bowls and cups.

examples.japanese: {瀬戸物|せともの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a china rice bowl.

examples.japanese: {瀬戸物|せともの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}として→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦{割|わ}って→割る：02334_waru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I dropped a piece of china and broke it.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{瀬戸物|せともの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新聞紙|しんぶんし}→新聞紙：20415_shinbunshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一|ひと}つずつ→一つずつ：24348_hitotsuzutsu⟧⟦{包|つつ}んで→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}めた→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧。
examples.english: When we moved, I wrapped each piece of china in newspaper and packed it in boxes.

notes:
Named for {瀬戸|せと} in Aichi Prefecture, long a center of pottery making. Traditionally eastern Japan said {瀬戸物|せともの} and western Japan {唐津物|からつもの}, after another pottery town.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瀬戸物|せともの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧: a china plate
- {瀬戸物|せともの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れる→割れる：00907_wareru⟧: china breaks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{陶磁器|とうじき}→陶磁器：15698_toujiki⟧: ceramics; the formal, general term
- ⟦{焼|や}き{物|もの}→焼き物：04974_yakimono⟧: pottery; also grilled food, so context matters
